description: Security Builder® FIPS Core provides application developers with cryptographics tools to easily integrate encryption, digital signatures and other security mechanisms into C-based apps for FIPS 140-2 and Suite B security. It can also be used with Certicom's PKI, IPSec and SSL modules.
